where_to_look: Oxford is Tommy Bahama plus Lilly Pulitzer plus Johnny Was, and the brands have diverged sharply. The segment table, not the consolidated comp, is where the surprise sits - and with 2 estimates the segment mix is not modelled

Tommy Bahama's business is heavily resort/coastal retail and full-price food-and-beverage (the Marlin Bars). Local weather and hurricane activity in Florida and the Gulf over June-August 2026 is a real, checkable revenue input that no screen carries
Lilly Pulitzer's flash-sale timing: OXM's Q2 result swings on where the Lilly 'After Party Sale' falls relative to the quarter boundary. Establish the 2026 date and compare it to 2025
Store-count and outlet-mix changes plus the promotional depth on tommybahama.com and lillypulitzer.com through August 2026 - full-price sell-through is the entire margin story for this name
No options chain and only 2 estimates on a $563m cap: what the market expects is unobservable, and the FY guide is what has moved the stock in recent quarters
